description: This file is the main component for a Tic Tac Toe game built using React. It maintains the game state and handles user interactions, displaying the game status and reset functionality.

methods.name: Square
methods.description: Functional component that renders a single square of the tic-tac-toe board, handles click events, and conditionally applies a CSS class for the winning square.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main component that manages the game state, calculates the winner, handles the game logic, and renders the game board.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Function that checks the current state of the squares to determine if there is a winner and returns the winner along with the winning line if available.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Handles click events on the squares, updates the state if the game is still active, and toggles the current player.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game state to start a new game by initializing squares and setting the first player.

methods.name: renderSquare
methods.description: Renders a Square component for a given index.
